panels.title: Network throughput (all hosts, per NIC sum)

targets.expr: (sum(vmware_exporter_host_red_alarms{instance=~"$target"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(vmware_exporter_vm_red_alarms{instance=~"$target"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (instance, ds_name)(vmware_exporter_datastore_red_alarms{instance=~"$target"})) or vector(0))

(sum(vmware_exporter_host_yellow_alarms{instance=~"$target"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(vmware_exporter_vm_yellow_alarms{instance=~"$target"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(max by (instance, ds_name)(vmware_exporter_datastore_yellow_alarms{instance=~"$target"})) or vector(0))

panels.title: Powered on VMs without running VMware Tools

targets.expr: vmware_exporter_vm_guest_tools_running_status{instance=~"$target"} == 0 and on (instance, vm_name, host_name) (vmware_exporter_vm_power_state{instance=~"$target"} == 1) and on (instance, vm_name, host_name) (vmware_exporter_vm_template{instance=~"$target"} == 0)
